Every brick and tile in the Censure Court is made of modular parts. It is both an elegant garden and a prison for holding and purging Tacet Discords.
Within the Censure Court, there is a type of scout Autopuppet specialized in investigation and patrol. It usually conceals itself in the form of door rings, relief sculptures, and the like, surveying within the Censure Court.
